dialogue.content: こんばんは　相談員です宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 初めに、年齢と性別をお願いします
dialogue.English: To begin, may I have your age and gender, please?

dialogue.content: 18歳、女性です。
dialogue.English: I'm 18 and female.

dialogue.content: 18歳の方ですね　今、何年生ですか？
dialogue.English: I see, you're 18. What year are you in school now?

dialogue.content: 大学一年生です。
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year university student.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 将来に希望が持てません。
dialogue.English: I can't feel hopeful about the future.

dialogue.content: 将来に希望が持てないのですねそれは不安ですね
dialogue.English: You can't feel hopeful about the future. That must be unsettling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそう感じるようになりましたか？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling that way?

dialogue.content: うーん、はっきり意識し始めたのは
dialogue.English: Hmm, I think when I started to become clearly aware of it...

dialogue.content: 高校を卒業したあたりからかなあ・・・・・
dialogue.English: ...was around the time I graduated from high school, I think.

dialogue.content: これまで、
dialogue.English: Up until now,

dialogue.content: 挫折の連続で、
dialogue.English: it's just been one setback after another,

dialogue.content: この先、何やっても同じかな、みたいな。
dialogue.English: so I kind of feel like no matter what I do from here on, it'll all be the same.

dialogue.content: なるほど高校を卒業したあたりから感じ始めて、これまで挫折の連続で、この先何をしても同じかなと感じているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you started feeling this way around the time you graduated from high school, and because you've experienced a series of setbacks, you now feel that no matter what you do, the outcome will likely be the same.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは辛いですねどのようなことで、挫折があったと思いますか？
dialogue.English: That must be difficult. In what ways do you feel you've had setbacks?

dialogue.content: 塾や習い事などを、母親から強制的にやらされていて、
dialogue.English: My mother forced me to go to cram school and take other lessons,

dialogue.content: やめたいといっても聞いてもらえませんでした。
dialogue.English: and even when I said I wanted to quit, she wouldn't listen.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね塾や習い事をお母様から強制的に行きなさいと言われて、
dialogue.English: I see. Your mother forced you to go to cram school and lessons,

dialogue.content: 辞めたいと言っても聴いてもらえなかったのですね分かってもらえないのは淋しいですよね
dialogue.English: and when you said you wanted to quit, you weren't heard. It's lonely when you're not understood, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それがトラウマ的で、
dialogue.English: It's become like a trauma for me,

dialogue.content: なかなか癒えません
dialogue.English: and I haven't really been able to heal from it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそのトラウマがなかなか癒えないのですね辛いですね塾や習い事で、どのようなことで挫折したと感じましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. That trauma isn't healing easily, and that must be painful. In those cram school and lessons, what made you feel like you'd had a setback?

dialogue.content: 自分的にはガッツリ頑張って来たのに、
dialogue.English: From my perspective, I put in a ton of effort,

dialogue.content: 報われなかったことです。
dialogue.English: but it never paid off.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いでしょうか。
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね自分ではガッツリ頑張ったのに、報われなかったと感じているのですねそれは悔しいですね
dialogue.English: I hear you. You feel that you put in a lot of effort but it wasn't rewarded. That must be very frustrating.

dialogue.content: 悔しいというより、
dialogue.English: More than frustrating,

dialogue.content: 苦しかったし、自分はダメなヤツかな、みたいな。
dialogue.English: it was painful, and I started to feel like maybe I'm just no good.

dialogue.content: そう思うと辛いです
dialogue.English: It's painful to think that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね苦しかったし、自分はダメな人と感じたのですねそれは確かにお辛いですねどうして自分はダメな人だと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It was painful, and you felt that you were no good. That is certainly very difficult. What makes you think that you're no good?

dialogue.content: 塾や習い事をしてたけど、
dialogue.English: Even though I was going to cram school and taking lessons,

dialogue.content: これといって成果みたいなものもなかったから。
dialogue.English: I have no real results to show for it.

dialogue.content: 毎日やることばかりで、
dialogue.English: Every day was just filled with things I had to do,

dialogue.content: 頑張って来たのに・・・っていう感じです。
dialogue.English: and it feels like... even though I worked so hard...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね頑張ってきたのに、これといった成果がなかったと感じたのですねそれは塾や習い事に行くのが嫌になりますね
dialogue.English: I see. You feel that despite all your hard work, you didn't achieve any notable results. That would certainly make anyone dislike going to cram school and lessons.

dialogue.content: それでも頑張って通われていたのですね凄いことだと思います
dialogue.English: And yet, you persevered and kept going. I think that's incredible.

dialogue.content: もう大学生になったので、塾や習い事からは解放されたんですが、
dialogue.English: Now that I'm a university student, I'm free from cram school and lessons, but...

dialogue.content: やっと少しずつ自分の時間が出来たので
dialogue.English: now that I finally have a little time for myself,

dialogue.content: その当時の辛かったおもいが押し寄せて来てる感じです。
dialogue.English: it feels like all the painful feelings from that time are flooding in.

dialogue.content: なるほど塾や習い事から解放されて自分の時間が出来たら、当時の辛かった思いが押し寄せてきているのですねそれはしんどいですね
dialogue.English: I see. So now that you're free from those obligations and have your own time, the painful feelings from that period are rushing in. That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: 他にも挫折を感じたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you experienced setbacks in other areas as well?

dialogue.content: 塾と習い事関係だけです。
dialogue.English: Just in relation to cram school and lessons.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねその時のことが今でもトラウマになっていると感じているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. And you feel that what happened back then is still a trauma for you now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、相談者さんの気持ちが少しでも楽になるように、一緒に考えてみましょう
dialogue.English: Okay, let's think together about how we can help you feel even a little better.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、今日はどのようなことを一番お話ししたいですか？
dialogue.English: So, what would you most like to focus on today?

dialogue.content: ただただ楽しい時間を過ごしてみたいです。
dialogue.English: I just want to have a purely enjoyable time.

dialogue.content: トラウマから解放されたいです。
dialogue.English: I want to be free from this trauma.

dialogue.content: うんうん楽しい時間を過ごしてみたいのですね？相談者さんにとって、楽しい時間とはどんなことしている時間でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, you want to experience having a good time. For you, what does "a good time" look like?

dialogue.content: 以前は習い事とかが休みの日は楽しかったですけど、
dialogue.English: I used to enjoy my days off from lessons, but...

dialogue.content: 今は何にも楽しいと感じられなくて。
dialogue.English: now I can't find enjoyment in anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねイメージしてみるとしたら、どんな風に過ごしていると「楽しい」と思えると思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you were to imagine it, how do you think you would need to spend your time to feel that it's "fun"?

dialogue.content: 分からないので困りました
dialogue.English: I don't know, and that's the problem.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよゆっくり考えてみて下さい
dialogue.English: That's alright. Please take your time to think about it.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いか教えて下さい
dialogue.English: Please tell me what to do.

dialogue.content: 以前はどんなことが楽しかったですか？
dialogue.English: What did you enjoy doing in the past?

dialogue.content: 以前は習い事とかが休みの日は楽しかったです。てゆうか、気楽だった感じでした。
dialogue.English: Before, I enjoyed my days off from lessons. Or rather, it felt more like I was at ease.

dialogue.content: うんうんそうなのですね休日はどんなことをしていましたか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it was. What did you do on your days off?

dialogue.content: 今はなにをしても楽しいと思えないんです。
dialogue.English: Now, I can't seem to find joy in anything I do.

dialogue.content: 当時は疲れて昼寝したりしてたので、
dialogue.English: Back then, I was so tired I would often just take a nap,

dialogue.content: 普通にテレビ見たり出来るのが嬉しかったかな？
dialogue.English: so I guess I was just happy to be able to do normal things, like watch TV.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね疲れて寝てしまうほど、ハードな日々だったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. Your days were so demanding that you were exhausted enough to just fall asleep.

dialogue.content: やめたいとか言うと、罵倒されたり叩かれたりしましたから。
dialogue.English: Because if I said anything about wanting to quit, I would be verbally abused or hit.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね罵倒されたり、叩かれたりしたのですねどんな気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. You were verbally abused and hit. How did that make you feel?

dialogue.content: 辛かった
dialogue.English: It was painful.

dialogue.content: けれどいつも、
dialogue.English: But I was always...

dialogue.content: やることばかりで、考えてる暇も無かった。
dialogue.English: so overwhelmed with things to do that I didn't even have time to think.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねお辛かったんですねそれでもやることに追われて考える時間もなかったんですね親御さんに分かってもらえない中、本当にお一人で頑張って、苦しかったですね
dialogue.English: I see, that must have been so painful. And on top of that, you were so overwhelmed with things to do that you didn't even have time to think. It must have been so difficult to endure all of that alone, without your parents understanding.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はそれらから解放されたのですから、楽しみたいですよね
dialogue.English: Now that you're free from all of that, you want to be able to enjoy yourself, right?

dialogue.content: はい、それが知りたくて来ました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's what I came here to find out.

dialogue.content: 例えばですが、環境を変えてみるのは、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As one example, how about trying to change your environment?

dialogue.content: 環境？どんな環境をですか？
dialogue.English: Environment? What kind of environment?

dialogue.content: 例えば、今はどのような家族構成ですか？
dialogue.English: For instance, who do you live with now?

dialogue.content: 両親、わたし、です。
dialogue.English: My parents and me.

dialogue.content: なるほどそれであれば、一人暮らしを始めてみる、とか、もしバイトとかサークルとかしていなければ、やってみる、などです。いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, one possibility is to try living on your own. Or, if you don’t have a part-time job or belong to a club, you could try something like that. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 一人暮らしは無理だと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think living on my own is possible.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね他のことはいががですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What about the other suggestions?

dialogue.content: サークルは分かりませんが、バイトは？また反対されそうです。
dialogue.English: I'm not sure about clubs... but a part-time job? I have a feeling they'd oppose that again.

dialogue.content: うんうん相談者さんはそう思うのですねぜひ一度ご両親に相談してみるのはいかがでしょうか？これはあくまでも一例です
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you're thinking. How about trying to discuss it with your parents just once? Of course, this is just one example.

dialogue.content: また罵倒されたりするのは、もう嫌だから。
dialogue.English: Because I don't want to be verbally abused again.

dialogue.content: どんなことでもいいので、何か一つでも今まで経験したことのないことをしてみると、感じたことのない風景が見えてくるかもしれませんが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It could be anything at all, but if you try doing even one thing you've never experienced before, it might open up a new perspective you've never seen. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね・・・
dialogue.English: That's true...

dialogue.content: では、今日の相談は終了のお時間になりました
dialogue.English: Well, it looks like our time is up for today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ぜひこれまでの殻を破って色々なことに目を向けてみて下さい応援していますありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Please try to break out of your shell and turn your attention to new and different things. I’m rooting for you. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: (相談者役、お疲れ様でした　ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work in the client role. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました、この後すぐに評価を作成致します)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. I will prepare the evaluation immediately.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
